text:
maria: hey team :wave: i'm a new hire (first week). trying to get admin rights to Redwood Console (staging) and access to the feature-flags panel so i can run onboarding evals. my okta doesn't show the console-staging-admin group. who do i ask or what ticket do i open?

sam: welcome! you should open an Access Request in the IT portal -> 'Console (Staging) - Admin' and check the 'feature-flag-edit' box. include your manager and okta email. IT will add you to the console-staging-admin group. if you want, i can speed it up once you post your okta id here.

maria: thanks — manager is leah. okta id is maria.g@redwood.dev. opening the portal now.

sam: cool, filing a shortcut ticket for you so we can track it here. created INC-8921 and CC'd it to it-oncall.

access-bot: Ticket INC-8921 created by sam and assigned to it-oncall. Status: Pending approval.

leah: @sam i'll approve once the manager field is filled (i see it now). maria — could you paste your employee id too so IT can verify?

maria: employee id 88421. thanks!

access-bot: INC-8921 approved by leah. Group membership propagation to console-staging-admin may take up to 15–30 minutes.

ben: quick heads-up for when you're in: the feature-flags UI still requires a separate role (feature-flag-edit). if you're blocked, you can also query flags via the staging API: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://console.staging.redwood.ai/api/flags?env=staging"` — replace $TOKEN with your session token. there is a short runbook here: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/console-onboarding (internal).

maria: perfect, i'll try the UI once the group shows up.

sam: once you're added ping me and i'll walk through safe rollouts + canary toggles in a quick screen share. also FYI don't use prod flags for evals — use staging-only toggles.

maria: understood, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
